name: hankel
expr: H1 = hankel([1 2 3 4]); H2 = hankel([1 2 3], [3 5 6 7]); H3 = hankel(1:6); Hc = hankel([1+1i 2+2i 3+3i]); hc11r = real(Hc(1,1)); hc11i = imag(Hc(1,1)); hc22r = real(Hc(2,2)); hc22i = imag(Hc(2,2)); Hr = hankel([1+1i 2 3],[3 4 5+5i]); hr13 = real(Hr(1,3)); hr33r = real(Hr(3,3)); hr33i = imag(Hr(3,3)); Hs = hankel(single([1 2 3])); hs_is = double(strcmp(class(Hs),'single')); hs13 = double(Hs(1,3));
comment: Sig: H = hankel(c[, r]). H[i,j] = c[i+j] for i+j<m else r[i+j-m+1]; single-arg form: r all zeros (anti-triangular). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: was DOUBLE-only — dropped the imaginary part of COMPLEX inputs and down-converted SINGLE. Now preserves COMPLEX (per-element gather, hankel NEVER conjugates: Hc(2,2)=c(3)=3+3i) and SINGLE class; two-arg complex keeps r's imaginary part (Hr(3,3)=5+5i). char/logical rejected by MATLAB (not added here). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b across complex + single probes.
